findings.message: Rows are split without regard to `Store`; the same Store can be in training and evaluation rows, so the score does not measure performance on new entities.

suggested_fix.description: Split by entity: use GroupShuffleSplit with groups=`Store` (same folds, test size and seed).

findings.message: Time-ordered rows are split without respecting time; the model trains on rows that are later than rows it is evaluated on.

evidence.detail: column `Date` (parsed as datetime); column `Month` (date-like name); column `Quarter` (date-like name); column `Week` (date-like name); column `Year` (date-like name)

suggested_fix.description: Sort by time and split without shuffling (shuffle=False), or use TimeSeriesSplit with the same number of folds.
